external_validity: The 45% figure is from a cloud-network IT-operations incident platform, NOT from coding agents. Its own limitations section states results come from a single organization and domain and that thresholds should be re-derived elsewhere. Applying it to TraceLab's coding-agent workload is a transfer assumption, not a measurement. The paper also notes the benefit shrinks in environments dominated by genuinely novel one-off work.
